selected.name: agent-selected
selected.vector_store: Chroma 1.5.9, collection day6_A (265 chunks, fixed 500 chars, overlap 50)
selected.filter: only the user-provided 'filter' field in the question (chapter), never gold

selection_criteria_in_order: 1. Grounded answer mean on dev (higher is better)
2. False abstention on dev (lower is better), abstention on unanswerable must stay 2/2
4. Retrieval latency and token cost as tie-breaker
rationale: Budget 1800 fixes the 2 false abstentions caused by evidence being cut at 800 chars, for about +25% tokens. Dense ties hybrid+rerank on dev retrieval quality but is about 10x faster, so dense is kept.
